# Granted Capital Funding

> Granted Capital Funding, by Aaron Lee Enterprises, is a US business funding and credit services site. It helps eligible US LLC owners and entrepreneurs seek up to $50,000 to $150,000+ in 0% introductory APR business credit for 12 to 18 months, arranged through third-party bank underwriting. Approval is not guaranteed.

Founder: Aaron Lee, Founder & Chief Capital Strategist.

## Programs

- 0% APR Business Funding: sequenced applications for business credit lines and cards, typically 12–18 months of introductory 0% APR. Core eligibility generally includes a 680+ personal credit score across the three bureaus and an active US LLC or corporation in good standing. No collateral, tax returns, or upfront equity are required according to the site.
- No Minimum Credit Score options: revenue-based funding discussed on a strategy call for businesses with about $10,000/month in revenue (site figure).
- Credit Restoration: credit services for disputing inaccurate report items; governed by the Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA). Consumers may dispute inaccurate information directly with consumer reporting agencies at no charge.
- Credit to Keys: mortgage-readiness guidance.

## Disclosures

- Granted Capital Funding is not a direct bank or lender.
- Affiliate disclosure: the site may earn a commission on MyScoreIQ sign-ups made through its links.
- Contact via the phone and email shown on the home page.
